statement.p: Find the flux of the vector field \vec J = 4 y^2 z\, \vec j+4 x\, \vec k out of the closed box 0\le x\le 2, 0\le y\le 6, 0\le z\le 8.

static.solution: \mbox{div }\vec J = 8 y z, if W is the interior of the box, the Divergence Theorem gives \hbox{Flux } = \int_W 8 y z\,dV = \int_0^{8}\int_0^{6}\int_0^{2} 8 y z\,dx\,dy\,dz = 2 x\bigg|_0^{2} y^2\bigg|_0^{6} z^2\bigg|_0^{8} = 9216.
